mechanics.claim: The active's bonus damage scales up to a 70% cap based on Dr. Mundo's missing health, at 0.57% per 1% missing health.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''Dr. Mundo's missing''' health|0 to {{#expr:{{#var:mod}}*100-100}} for 11|0 to 70|formula=0.57% per missing health %, up to a cap of 70%.|color=health}}

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup and resets Dr. Mundo's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Blunt Force Trauma basic attack reset resets Dr. Mundo's basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts only after the empowered attack lands (post-effect).
If the target dies, its corpse deals area damage equal to 100% AD plus the ability's minimum bonus damage to enemies it passes through, but this corpse damage cannot critically strike.
mechanics.quote: The damage of the enemy's corpse colliding with enemies does not benefit from ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' attack {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack and corpse-fling damage against structures still deals full damage and consumes the buff.
mechanics.quote: ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' attack works against {{tip|structures}}, consuming the buff and dealing its full damage.
